dimensions.assessment: Involves federal agencies including the Forest Service, Department of the Interior, and specific congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Forest Service and the Department of the Interior to (1) jointly evaluate the container aerial firefighting system

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an administrative evaluation and report rather than operational deployment or funding changes.
dimensions.evidence: conduct an evaluation with respect to the use of the container aerial firefighting system

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or spending levels are stated in the source text.
A focused procedural requirement for an evaluation and report on a specific firefighting technology.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the appropriate committees a report that includes the results of the evaluation

dimensions.assessment: One-time reporting requirements with short deadlines (90 and 120 days after enactment).
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Whether the evaluation could lead to future procurement or programmatic changes.
Cost estimates for conducting the evaluation.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires a federal evaluation and congressional report on the container aerial firefighting system within specific deadlines.
